headings.usage: Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers (text-3xl to 5xl). Never use for body text.

body.usage: Highly legible, geometric feel for data points, toggle labels, and list items.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl and backdrop-saturate-150 on top of the surface colors. Ensure 1px inner border (border border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a global noise/grain texture overlaid on the background using the provided dark_grain_texture image with mix-blend-overlay and opacity-20.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use colored drop shadows for active elements (e.g., shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(224,93,38,0.3)]).

components.device_card: Bento item. Must display an icon, device name, and state. When active, use accent color for icon and bright border. Use framer-motion whileTapping={ scale: 0.95 }.
components.mic_button: HERO ELEMENT. Massive, floating action button. When listening, animate 2-3 concentric pulsing rings using framer-motion. Glowing shadow is mandatory.
components.bottom_nav: Floating pill shape at the bottom, not full width. Fixed position, z-50. Glassmorphism background.
components.slider: Custom styled range input or framer-motion drag element for AC/Fan. Thick track, vibrant active fill color.
components.forms: Use border-b only or heavily rounded floating inputs. Do not use generic outlined inputs.

grids.dashboard: Mobile-first bento grid. grid-cols-2 gap-4. Important devices can span col-span-2. Generous padding (p-5).

layouts.room_view: Top half contains the room background image with a heavy gradient-to-b overlay fading into the background color.
layouts.login: Immersive image background with heavy blur. Bold typography, asymmetrical layout.

motion.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide up (y: 20 -> y: 0) using framer-motion.
motion.micro_interactions: Tap scaling (0.95) on all interactive cards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over glassmorphism has minimum 4.5:1 contrast.
accessibility.test_ids: Every button, input, and card MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

living_room_bg.description: Background image for the Living Room details page

bedroom_bg.description: Background image for Bedroom details page

dark_grain_texture.description: Global background texture to overlay on the dark theme base

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and framer-motion.
Implement PWA settings in manifest.json and register a service worker.
Configure global state (Context/Zustand) for User, Server IP, and Port.
Admin user password is 'admin0466'. Enable user creation page for Admin only.
API endpoints: GET /api/devices, POST /api/devices/control, GET/POST /api/shopping-list, POST /api/parse-command, POST /api/parse-audio, POST /api/tts, GET /api/audio/:id.
Audio upload MUST use MediaRecorder API and POST to /api/parse-audio as form-data.
Handle playback of the audio response properly.
NEVER use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical or heavily padded designs.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds over content without blur/scrim.
design_system.UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight. Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). You MUST NOT center align the app container. Never use AI assistant Emojis. Use Sonner for toasts.
